title: Online news users among India's 886M active internet users, 2024 (IAMAI-Kantar ICUBE)

rows.label: Conscious online news users (seek it out)

metadata.vintage: IAMAI-Kantar ICUBE 'Internet in India 2024' (rel. Jan 2025); 2025 from press release.
metadata.note: Online News Users = encounter news online (via apps, social, forwards, YouTube) consciously or unconsciously. Conscious Online News Users = deliberately seek news. '3 of 5 internet users encounter news online, but only 1 in 5 consciously read it.'
